dialogue.content: 10時からよろしくお願い致します。
dialogue.English: I'm looking forward to our session at 10:00. Thank you.

dialogue.content: こちらこそよろしくお願いします。
dialogue.English: Thank you as well. I look forward to our session.

dialogue.content: クライアントのご希望はありますか？
dialogue.English: Do you have any preferences for the client role?

dialogue.content: お任せします。
dialogue.English: I’ll leave it up to you.

dialogue.content: 承知しましたいつでもスタート大丈夫です
dialogue.English: Understood. I'm ready to start whenever you are.

dialogue.content: きょうはどんな相談でしょうか？年代と性別をおねがいします。
dialogue.English: What brings you here today? Could you please tell me your age range and gender?

dialogue.content: 死にたい…
dialogue.English: I want to die...

dialogue.content: 30代、女です
dialogue.English: I’m a woman in my 30s.

dialogue.content: そんなにおもいつめているのですね。はなせるところから話してください。少しでもあなたの話を聴きますよ。
dialogue.English: It sounds like you're feeling incredibly overwhelmed. Please, tell me what's on your mind, starting from wherever you're comfortable. I'm here to listen to you.

dialogue.content: 仕事もないし、彼氏にもフラレたし、もう生きててもしょうがない
dialogue.English: I don't have a job, my boyfriend dumped me... there's no point in living anymore.

dialogue.content: 生きていく希望を失ったのですね。今はどんな生活をしていますか？
dialogue.English: So you've lost the will to go on. What is your life like at the moment?

dialogue.content: 貯金を切り崩して生活してるけど、もうそんなに貯金もないし、
dialogue.English: I'm living off my savings, but I don't have much left...

dialogue.content: お酒ばっかり飲んでる
dialogue.English: And I just drink all the time.

dialogue.content: かなり生活もくるしいですね。それでお酒を飲んで忘れたい気持ちなのですね。
dialogue.English: It sounds like your life is very difficult right now. And so you drink because you want to forget.

dialogue.content: お金もないのにお酒に溺れて、最低ですよね
dialogue.English: I'm drowning myself in alcohol even though I have no money... I'm the worst, aren't I?

dialogue.content: お酒に頼りたい気持ちですよね。あまりにも悲しすぎて忘れたいですよね。
dialogue.English: It’s understandable that you want to rely on alcohol. The sadness is so overwhelming that you want to forget.

dialogue.content: もう私のことなんて誰も心配しないだろうしこのまま死んでも誰も気づかないだろうし
dialogue.English: No one cares about me anymore, and if I died just like this, no one would even notice.

dialogue.content: そんなところまで考えて淋しいでしょう。だれか家族や友達、同僚の方で連絡はとれる方いますか？
dialogue.English: It must be so lonely to think that way. Is there anyone—family, friends, or colleagues—that you can contact?

dialogue.content: 別にもう、淋しいとかそういう感情はないです
dialogue.English: I don’t really feel lonely or anything like that anymore.

dialogue.content: 誰にも連絡取ってない
dialogue.English: I’m not in touch with anyone.

dialogue.content: 取りたくない、こんな状況知られたくない
dialogue.English: I don’t want to reach out. I don’t want anyone to know about my situation.

dialogue.content: 誰にも知られずこのまま消えたい
dialogue.English: I just want to disappear without anyone knowing.

dialogue.content: そこまでの気持ちなのですね。そうですよね。誰とも連絡取りたくないですね。
dialogue.English: That's how strongly you feel. I can understand that. You don't want to contact anyone.

dialogue.content: 誰かに話して分かってもらえるはずないから
dialogue.English: Because there's no way anyone would understand if I told them.

dialogue.content: よくここに話しにきてくれましたね。勇気がいるのに・・・ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: I'm so glad you came to talk to me today. It must have taken a lot of courage... thank you.

dialogue.content: こちらこそ、訳分かんない私の話を聞いてくれて、ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: No, thank you for listening to my nonsensical rambling.

dialogue.content: 誰かにはなしてもわかってもらえない・・・だれもしんじたくないのでしょうか
dialogue.English: "No one would understand if I told them"... Does that mean you don't want to trust anyone?

dialogue.content: 信じても結局、最後は裏切るでしょう
dialogue.English: Even if I trust someone, they'll just betray me in the end.

dialogue.content: きっとあなたの話を聴いてくれる人はいますよ。裏切り、あなたはきっとよほど辛い目にあったのですね。
dialogue.English: I'm sure there are people who will listen to you. Betrayal... you must have gone through something incredibly painful.

dialogue.content: ここで今までの事話して少しでも楽になって欲しいです。
dialogue.English: I hope that by talking about what’s happened here, you can feel even a little bit lighter.

dialogue.content: 辛かったけど、それも仕方ないこんな私とは一緒にいたくないって思うのも当たり前だろうなって、今は思うけど、辛かった信じてたから
dialogue.English: It was painful, but I guess it can't be helped. Now I think it's only natural that they wouldn't want to be with someone like me. But it was painful... because I trusted them.

dialogue.content: そう、誰だって信じたいですよ、人を
dialogue.English: Yes, everyone wants to trust people.

dialogue.content: 信じて傷つくだけなら、もう一人でいた方がいいし
dialogue.English: If trusting people only leads to getting hurt, then I'm better off alone.

dialogue.content: でも、生きてることも疲れたし
dialogue.English: But I’m tired of being alive, too.

dialogue.content: お金ももうなくなるから、もう死んでもいいかなって
dialogue.English: And my money is about to run out, so I think it might be okay to just die.

dialogue.content: もう、信じて傷つきたくないのね。
dialogue.English: You don't want to trust and get hurt anymore.

dialogue.content: そう、傷つきなくない
dialogue.English: Yeah, I don’t want to be hurt.

dialogue.content: この先生きてても、なんかもういいことないだろうし
dialogue.English: Even if I keep living, there probably won't be anything good anymore.

dialogue.content: お金はなんとかしないとね。給付金だってなんとか手続きしてもらう方法はあるかと・・
dialogue.English: We need to address the money issue. There may be ways to get help with applying for benefits.

dialogue.content: あなたは傷つきやすい優しい方でしょう。きっと
dialogue.English: You seem like a kind and sensitive person, I'm sure of it.

dialogue.content: 私みたいな人間が給付金とかもらって生き延びても、お金の無駄って思う
dialogue.English: Even if someone like me gets benefits and survives, I think it's just a waste of money.

dialogue.content: だから、もう傷つきたくないのでしょう。
dialogue.English: That's why you don't want to be hurt anymore, right?

dialogue.content: 窓口で話すことで気が少し楽になって欲しいな。
dialogue.English: I hope that talking to someone at a support office might help ease your feelings a bit.

dialogue.content: そうですね、傷つきたくないから死にます
dialogue.English: You’re right. I’ll die so I won’t get hurt anymore.

dialogue.content: 聞いてくれてありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you for listening.

dialogue.content: あなたが希望を持って生きることを望む１人です。
dialogue.English: I am one person who wants you to live with hope.

dialogue.content: どうしたら希望を持てますか？
dialogue.English: How can I find hope?

dialogue.content: こんな私が生きてて、なんの意味がある？
dialogue.English: What's the point of someone like me being alive?

dialogue.content: あなたはどんなことに希望をもてますか？どんなことがすき？ここに生きていることじたい意味や価値があるとおもう。
dialogue.English: What are some things that could give you hope? What do you like? I believe there is meaning and value in the very fact that you are alive.

dialogue.content: 仕事だって続けたかったし、彼氏と結婚したかった
dialogue.English: I wanted to keep my job, and I wanted to marry my boyfriend.

dialogue.content: でも、それももう、全部無くなった
dialogue.English: But all of that is gone now.

dialogue.content: だから、生きてる意味ないでしょう
dialogue.English: So there's no reason to live, is there?

dialogue.content: そうですよね。仕事はどんなことで辞めたのでですか？
dialogue.English: I see. What led to you quitting your job?

dialogue.content: コロナでクビになった
dialogue.English: I was laid off because of COVID.

dialogue.content: 彼とはどんな人だったの？
dialogue.English: What was your boyfriend like?

dialogue.content: 話せるところから聴きます
dialogue.English: I'll listen to whatever you feel comfortable sharing.

dialogue.content: 彼氏は結婚の話も出てたけど、私の友達と浮気してた
dialogue.English: My boyfriend and I were even talking about marriage, but he was cheating on me with my friend.

dialogue.content: コロナで？それは悔しいですよ。あなたは何も非がないようにかんじますけど、
dialogue.English: Because of COVID? That's so frustrating. It sounds like it wasn't your fault at all.

dialogue.content: 仕事は、10年一生懸命頑張って貢献してたのに、簡単に切り捨てられた
dialogue.English: I worked so hard and contributed to my job for 10 years, and they just threw me away so easily.

dialogue.content: 彼氏だってそう友達もそう信じてたのに、知らなかったのは私だけ
dialogue.English: It was the same with my boyfriend and my friend. I trusted them, but I was the only one who didn't know.

dialogue.content: 彼氏もなんと裏切られた感でいっぱい１０年頑張ってこられたのに、ひどい
dialogue.English: Your boyfriend too... you must feel so betrayed. And after working so hard for 10 years... that's just terrible.

dialogue.content: ね、ひどいでしょう
dialogue.English: It is terrible, isn't it?

dialogue.content: 友達にも裏切られた感ありますね。悲しみのどん底ですね。
dialogue.English: And to be betrayed by your friend as well. You must be at the depths of despair.

dialogue.content: だから、もう、頑張ることも信じることも、怖いししたくない
dialogue.English: That's why I'm scared to try hard or trust anyone anymore. I don't want to.

dialogue.content: でも、そのどん底からはいあがりましょう。だってあなたは１０年もの間がんばってきたのだから。
dialogue.English: But let’s climb up from that rock bottom—because you're someone who has worked so hard for ten years.

dialogue.content: いや、もう、頑張りたくない
dialogue.English: No, I don't want to try anymore.

dialogue.content: それに彼は友達と浮気してひどい。もし、結婚したらどんな生活か考えてみてください。
dialogue.English: Besides, he was a terrible person for cheating with your friend. Imagine what your life would have been like if you had married him.

dialogue.content: そうなのね、頑張りたくないよね
dialogue.English: I see. You don't want to try anymore.

dialogue.content: そんなに頑張らなくていいよだってあなたは今まで頑張ってきたのだから。
dialogue.English: You don't have to try so hard. You've been trying your best all this time.

dialogue.content: どんなときも、きっと疲れたときは休むことも必要だよ。
dialogue.English: It's always necessary to rest when you're tired.

dialogue.content: どうしたら、楽に死ねますか
dialogue.English: How can I die painlessly?

dialogue.content: そこまで思い詰めてあまりにも悲しすぎる
dialogue.English: To think you've been driven to this point... it's just too sad.

dialogue.content: あなたを支える人になりたい気持ちです。
dialogue.English: I want to be someone who supports you.

dialogue.content: どうか命だけは大切にして欲しいな・・
dialogue.English: Please, I just want you to treasure your life...

dialogue.content: 命を大切にしたら、なにかいいことありますか？
dialogue.English: If I treasure my life, will anything good happen?

dialogue.content: いきてるだけでいいよ。素晴らしいあなただから。
dialogue.English: Just being alive is enough. Because you are a wonderful person.

dialogue.content: 私のどこが素晴らしいの？
dialogue.English: What’s wonderful about me?

dialogue.content: 今まで彼や友達の裏切りに遇い、仕事は１０年頑張ってきたのだから
dialogue.English: Because you've endured betrayal from your boyfriend and friend, and you worked so hard at your job for 10 years.

dialogue.content: そうですか…
dialogue.English: I see...

dialogue.content: これからだって仕事見つけて欲しいと思う。だってこんなに一生懸命いきているのに
dialogue.English: I hope you'll find another job. Because you've been living so earnestly.

dialogue.content: （時間ですね。ありがとうございました）
dialogue.English: (I see our time is up. Thank you very much.)

dialogue.content: もったいない、あなただからこそいきてください。これでロールプレイを終了します。ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: It would be such a loss. Please live, precisely because of the person you are. This concludes the role-play. Thank you.
